// diagnostic

E3305

`{operation}` is not available for target `{target}`.

What

`{operation}` is not available for target `{target}`.

Why

The selected target has no Prelude adapter for `{operation}`; WASI Preview 2 provides TCP/UDP sockets but not this operation.

Fix

use a supported TCP/UDP operation, or build for a native target.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3305: tests/ui/wasip2_unsupported_socket_operation_e3305.stderr.

Error [E3305]: `core.net.unix_listen` is not available for target `wasm32-wasip2`.

 Fix: use a supported TCP/UDP operation, or build for a native target.
